latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the critic assignment. I saved the full review at [critique.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/B-01/control/critic/critique.md) and the independent source map and evidence index at [source-map.json](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/B-01/control/critic/source-map.json) and [sources/README.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/B-01/control/critic/sources/README.md). The map passed JSON validation, and all nine evidence-note paths exist.

The main findings are that P4’s high-contrast controls and seasonal handoff view were incorrectly called optional, and V1 should test actual half-shift desk-to-loading continuity. The review also recommends a restart and staff-session test for Firestore on the selected tablet platform: its defaults differ by platform, and current web documentation describes memory cache as the default with persistent cache configured separately ([offline-data docs](https://firebase.google.com/docs/firestore/manage-data/enable-offline), [JavaScript API reference](https://firebase.google.com/docs/reference/js/firestore)). The historical PouchDB issue-to-8.0.1 fix chain was independently checked and remains narrowly scoped ([issue #8581](https://github.com/apache/pouchdb/issues/8581), [8.0.1 release](https://github.com/apache/pouchdb/releases/tag/8.0.1)).

No application or device tests were run; proposed validations are labeled as such. The native Goal was completed after the artifacts were saved; elapsed time was 4m 19s.
